Cut the chicken: Cut the chicken into small pieces, about 1.5 cm across, and put them in a bowl. Wash your hands, the knife and the board in hot soapy water straight after.

Cut the chicken: Cut the chicken into strips about 2 cm wide. Wash your hands, the knife and the board in hot soapy water straight after.
Cut the chicken: Cut the chicken into thin strips, about as thick as a pound coin. Wash your hands, the knife and the board in hot soapy water straight afterwards.

Cut the cucumber: Wash the cucumber, trim the ends and cut it into thin sticks, 5 to 6 cm long and about as thick as your little finger.

Cut the vegetable sticks: Peel the carrots and cut them into sticks about the length of a finger. Wash the cucumber, cut it in half across, then cut each half into long sticks.

Prepare the broccoli: As soon as the tray is in, boil the kettle. Wash the broccoli and cut it into small florets, about the size of a walnut. Slice any thick stalk about as thick as a pound coin.
Prepare the broccoli: While it roasts, cut the broccoli into small florets.
Prepare the cabbage and chestnuts: Quarter the red cabbage, cut out the hard white core and slice it into thin strips. Cut the chestnuts into quarters.
Prepare the cheese and lettuce: Grate the cheddar on the coarse side of a grater. Rinse the lettuce, shake it dry and tear it into small pieces.
Prepare the cheese and spinach: Grate the cheese on the coarse side of the grater. Rinse the spinach under cold water and shake it dry, unless the bag says it's ready washed.
Prepare the cheese and spinach: While the pasta cooks, grate the cheddar finely and rinse the spinach in a colander.

Prepare the cheese and tomatoes: Grate the cheddar on the large holes of the grater and set about a third aside for the top. Wash the tomatoes, cut out any hard core and slice them about as thick as a pound coin.

Prepare the chicken and cheese: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces, about 2 cm across, then wash your hands, the knife and the board in hot soapy water. Drain the mozzarella, pat it dry and tear it into small pieces.

Prepare the chicken and mushrooms: Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces, about 2 cm across, then wash your hands, the knife and the board in hot soapy water. Wipe the mushrooms clean and slice them about as thick as a pound coin.

Prepare the chicken: Cut the chicken into strips about 2 cm wide. Toss the chicken and peppers on a large baking tray with the oil and a grind of black pepper. Wash your hands, the knife and the board in hot soapy water.

Prepare the chickpeas and potatoes: Drain the chickpeas in a sieve and rinse them, then drain the potatoes. Pat both dry on a clean tea towel or kitchen paper so they turn golden. Cut the potatoes in half, or into quarters if very big.
Prepare the cucumber: Cut the cucumber into 1 cm chunks and slice the spring onions into thin rings. Put both in a bowl.
Prepare the filling: Grate the cheddar on the coarse side of a grater. Slice the spring onions thinly. Tear the ham into pieces about the size of a postage stamp.
Prepare the filling: Grate the cheddar on to a plate. Tear the ham into pieces about 2 cm across and put them beside the cheese.
Prepare the filling: Grate the cheese. Trim the spring onions and slice them thinly into rings, about as thick as a pound coin.

Prepare the gammon: Meanwhile, pat the gammon dry. It is already salty, so it needs nothing added. Snip the fat at the edge in a few places with scissors to stop it curling. Wash your hands straight after.
Prepare the lettuce and cheese: Rinse the lettuce, shake it dry and shred it into thin strips. Grate the cheddar on the coarse side of the grater.
Prepare the lettuce and cheese: Rinse the lettuce, shake it dry and shred it into thin strips. Grate the cheddar on the coarse side of the grater. Set both aside.
Prepare the lettuce: Meanwhile, wash the lettuce, shake it dry and cut or tear it into bite-sized pieces. Grate the cheddar.
Prepare the mushrooms: Wipe the mushrooms with damp kitchen paper and slice them thinly. Slice the spring onions thinly and set them aside for the end.

Prepare the onion and chicken: Peel the onion and chop it small, about the size of a pea. Cut the chicken into bite-sized chunks, about 3 cm across. Wash your hands, the knife and the board in hot soapy water afterwards.
Prepare the onion and chicken: Peel the onion and chop it small. Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces, about 2 cm across. Wash your hands, the knife and the board in hot soapy water straight after.
Prepare the onion and chickpeas: Peel the onion and chop it small, about the size of a pea. Drain the chickpeas in a sieve, rinse them under cold water and leave them to drain.

Prepare the onion and mushrooms: Peel the onion, cut it in half and chop it small, about the size of a pea. Wipe the mushrooms clean if they need it and slice them thinly, about as thick as a pound coin.
Prepare the onion and spinach: Peel the onion, cut it in half and chop it small, about the size of a pea. Rinse the spinach and shake it dry, unless the bag says it's ready washed.
Prepare the peppers: Cut the peppers in half from top to bottom and scoop out the seeds. Put them cut side up in a large ovenproof dish and rub them with a little of the oil.
Prepare the potatoes and onion: Drain the potatoes and cut them into slices about 1 cm thick. They are already cooked. Peel the onion and chop it small, about the size of a pea.
Prepare the potatoes: Drain the potatoes and pat them dry with kitchen paper so they brown well. Cut each in half, or into quarters if large. They are already cooked.
Prepare the potatoes: Drain the potatoes and pat them dry with kitchen paper so they go golden. Cut any large ones in half so the pieces are about the same size.
Prepare the potatoes: Drain the potatoes and pat them dry with kitchen paper so they go golden. Cut any large ones in half.
Prepare the potatoes: Drain the potatoes and shake off the water. Cut each one in half, and cut any large ones smaller so they are all about the same size.
Prepare the potatoes: Drain the potatoes, cut any large ones in half and put them in a large bowl.
Prepare the potatoes: Drain the potatoes, pat them dry with kitchen paper and cut each one in half.
Prepare the potatoes: Drain the potatoes, pat them dry with kitchen paper so they go crisp, and cut each one in half. Take the ham out of the fridge.
Prepare the rest: Slice the spring onions into thin rings and set them aside. Drain the sweetcorn if it is tinned.
Prepare the salad: Cut the lettuce into thin strips. Halve the tomatoes and slice them thinly. Halve the cucumber lengthways and slice it into half-moons about as thick as a pound coin.
Prepare the salad: Drain and rinse the chickpeas. Cut the cucumber into cubes about 1 cm across and halve the cherry tomatoes. Peel the red onion and slice it as thinly as you can.
Prepare the salad: Meanwhile, wash the lettuce, shake it dry and tear it into pieces. Halve the cherry tomatoes, slice the cucumber and grate the cheddar.
Prepare the salad: Rinse the lettuce and tomatoes and pat them dry. Halve the tomatoes, cut out the hard core and slice them thinly. Shred the lettuce into thin strips.
Prepare the salad: Rinse the spinach unless the bag says it is ready washed, and shake it dry. Slice the cucumber into thin rounds. Tear the smoked salmon into strips.
Prepare the salad: Wash the lettuce, shake it dry and shred it into thin strips. Grate the cheese on the coarse side of the grater.
Prepare the salad: Wash the lettuce, shake it dry and tear it into pieces. Cut the tomatoes into wedges and slice the cucumber. Drain the tuna well.
Prepare the salmon: Pull out any small bones, slice off any skin and cut the salmon into chunks about 3 cm across. Wash your hands, the knife and the board in hot soapy water.
Prepare the salmon: Take off any skin and cut the fish into large chunks, about 3 cm across. Feel the chunks with your fingertips for small bones and pull out any you find.
Prepare the spring onions: Trim off the roots and any floppy green tips, then slice the spring onions into thin rounds. Put them in a large mixing bowl.
Prepare the sprouts and chestnuts: Trim the base off each sprout, pull away any tired outer layers and cut it in half, or into quarters if large. Cut the chestnuts in half.
Prepare the sprouts: Meanwhile, trim the base off each sprout, pull away any tired outer layers and halve any big ones. Bring a medium pan of water from the kettle to the boil.
Prepare the tomatoes: Cut the tomatoes into wedges, or in half if they are small. Trim and thinly slice the spring onions, white and green parts.
Prepare the toppings: Grate the cheddar on the coarse side of the grater and slice the spring onions thinly.

Prepare the vegetables: Cut the broccoli into florets about 3 cm across and slice any thick stalk. Trim and thinly slice the spring onions. Halve the cucumber lengthways and slice it into half-moons about as thick as a pound coin.

Prepare the vegetables: Cut the broccoli into small florets, about 2 cm across, and slice any thick stalk thinly. Halve the pepper, pull out the stalk and seeds, and slice it into thin strips. Trim and thinly slice the spring onions.
Prepare the vegetables: Cut the roots off the spring onions and slice them thinly. Cut any big pieces of the stir-fry vegetables down so everything is about the same size.
Prepare the vegetables: Halve the pepper, pull out the stalk and seeds and slice it into thin strips. Cut the broccoli into small florets, about 2 cm across. Trim and thinly slice the spring onions.
Prepare the vegetables: Halve the pepper, scoop out the seeds and white inside and chop it into 1 cm pieces. Slice the spring onions thinly. Put both in a bowl.

Prepare the vegetables: Peel the carrot and grate it coarsely into a large bowl. Cut the cucumber into thin sticks about 5 cm long and add them. Slice the spring onions into thin rings and keep them aside.

Prepare the vegetables: Peel the carrot and slice it into thin rounds. Cut the broccoli into small florets, about 2 cm across. Halve the pepper, remove the stalk and seeds and slice it into 1 cm strips. Thinly slice the spring onions.
Prepare the vegetables: Peel the onion and chop it small. Cut the broccoli into small florets and slice the stalk thinly. Drain the potatoes and cut them in half.
Prepare the vegetables: Peel the onion and chop it small. Cut the peppers in half, scoop out the seeds and chop them into small pieces. Drain the chickpeas and rinse them under the cold tap.
Prepare the vegetables: Peel the onion and chop it small. Drain the potatoes and cut each one in half.
Prepare the vegetables: Peel the onion and chop it small. Peel the carrots and cut them into thin rounds. Drain the chickpeas in a sieve and rinse them under the cold tap.
Prepare the vegetables: Peel the onion and chop it small. Peel the carrots and slice them into thin rounds. Cut the pepper into bite-sized pieces.
Prepare the vegetables: Peel the onion and chop it small. Peel the carrots and slice them into thin rounds. Cut the peppers into bite-sized pieces and slice the mushrooms.
Prepare the vegetables: Peel the onion and chop it small. Peel the carrots and slice them into thin rounds. Cut the peppers into bite-sized pieces.
Prepare the vegetables: Peel the onion and chop it small. Wipe the mushrooms clean and slice them thinly.

Prepare the vegetables: Peel the onion, halve it and slice it thinly. Quarter the red cabbage, cut out the hard core and slice it into thin strips. Peel and core the apples and cut them into 1 cm chunks.
Prepare the vegetables: Trim and thinly slice the spring onions, white and green parts. Tip the stir-fry vegetables into a bowl. Loosen the noodles with your fingers so they are not stuck together.

Warm the tomatoes: Cut the cherry tomatoes in half and add them to the edge of the pan for the last 3 minutes, until soft. Move the cakes and tomatoes to a warm plate.
Warm the tomatoes: Halve the cherry tomatoes, add them to the chicken pan and stir for 1 minute, until just warm. Turn off the heat.
Warm the wraps: Heat a dry frying pan over a medium heat and warm the wraps for about 20 seconds on each side. Stack them under a clean tea towel.
Warm the wraps: Heat a dry frying pan over a medium heat. Warm each wrap for about 20 seconds on each side, so it bends without cracking.
Warm the wraps: Heat a large dry frying pan on a medium heat for 1 minute. Warm the wraps one at a time, about 20 seconds a side, then stack them under a clean tea towel.
Warm the wraps: Heat a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat. Warm the wraps in the dry pan for about 20 seconds on each side, then cover them with a clean tea towel.
Warm the wraps: Put a large non-stick frying pan on a medium heat. Warm the wraps in the dry pan one at a time, about 20 seconds a side, then stack them under a clean tea towel.
Warm the wraps: Put the pan back on a medium heat and warm each wrap in the dry pan for about 20 seconds a side, so it bends without cracking.
Warm the wraps: Warm the wraps in a dry frying pan for about 20 seconds on each side, or as the pack says, so they bend without cracking.
Warm the wraps: Warm the wraps in a dry non-stick frying pan for about 20 seconds on each side, so they bend without cracking. Cover them with a clean tea towel.
Warm the wraps: Warm the wraps in a second dry frying pan for about 20 seconds on each side, or as the pack says, so they bend without cracking. Stack them and keep them covered.
Warm the wraps: Warm the wraps in the dry pan, one or two at a time, for about 20 seconds on each side, or as the pack says. Stack them under a clean tea towel.
Warm the wraps: Warm the wraps one at a time in a dry non-stick frying pan over a medium heat, about 20 seconds a side, until they bend without cracking. Keep them under a clean tea towel.
Warm the wraps: Warm the wraps one at a time in a large dry non-stick frying pan on a medium heat, for about 20 seconds on each side. Wrap them in a clean tea towel.
Warm the wraps: Wipe out the frying pan and put it back on a medium heat. Warm the wraps one at a time for about 20 seconds on each side, then cover them with a clean tea towel.
Warm the wraps: Wipe the pan, put it on a low heat and warm each wrap for 20 seconds on each side, until soft and bendy.
